about: A new notebook as every tool that creates one writes it: the setup block importing the runtime module, then one empty cell. `alkera-notebook new` and the web client's newNotebookText are each tested against `text` with these ids in place.

__generated_with = "0.25.1"
app = marimo.App()

with app.setup(alkera_id="0000000001"):
    import alkera


@app.cell(alkera_id="0000000002")
def _():
    return


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run()
